description: This file defines a data transfer object (DTO) named ClientTransactionDTO used within the accounting journal entry context of the Fineract project. It encapsulates details related to client transactions such as client ID, office ID, transaction date, transaction type, amount, and related charge payments.

classes.name: ClientTransactionDTO
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object representing a client transaction, including transaction details and charge payments.

methods.name: isChargePayment
methods.description: Returns true if the transaction type indicates a charge payment.
